desc:
Would You Rather: Christmas Outfit Tower 🎄

Make your way up the tower by choosing between two mystery doors on every level 🚪✨
Every decision changes your outfit, for better or worse 😅

Unlock stylish hairstyles, trendy clothes, cool accessories, faces, and more to create the ultimate look 👗🕶️
But be careful… some choices might give you the funniest outfit ever 🤡

With A Lot of possible outfit combinations, every round is completely different 🎲

Reach the top to reveal your final style and compare outfits with your friends to see who has the best fashion sense 💃🔥

Don’t forget to like the game 👍 and join the Group for special rewards and perks 🎁
